assets.name: Plague Flask
assets.sourceDescription: A single round green poison potion bottle with a cork and a small skull label.
assets.gameDescription: Kills leave a poison puddle for 2 seconds. Smells like the undead town. Everything does.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one finished square inventory icon for a 3D action game. Style: Arcane (the League of Legends animated series), hand-painted 3D with sculptural volume, chiseled planes, visible directional brushwork, worn material surfaces, deep occlusion and selective sharp highlights. Strong three-quarter perspective and physical thickness; cinematic warm/cool contrast. Single centered subject fills about 78% of the square, entire silhouette comfortably inside the frame. Near-black painted background with a subtle contact shadow. Clear bold silhouette readable after downsampling to 400 x 400 and at 64px. Keep the form and materials more important than glow or tiny details. No text, letters, logos, watermark, card frame, UI, characters, extra items, collage, or scenery. Avoid flat vector art, thin cartoon outlines, photoreal photography and glossy smooth plastic.
Subject: One squat round thick-glass poison flask, cork stopper secured with weathered dark wire, sickly luminous green fluid swirling inside. A small aged parchment label with a simple skull pictogram only, no writing. Glass has uneven thickness, angular painted reflections and deep green refraction; dark leather neck wrapping, stained brass seal. An ominous trace of green vapor curls around the cork, restrained enough to preserve the silhouette. Sculptural translucent glass and murky fluid, cool teal edge light against toxic chartreuse core.
Game item context (do not render as text): Kills leave a poison puddle for 2 seconds. Smells like the undead town. Everything does.
